name: RC-B10-0146/2025/REV1 – § 7 – Am 4
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the white paper on the future of European defence
part_text: 7. Believes therefore that time has come for a renewed political ambition to act and turn the EU into a genuine security provider, increase the EU’s defence readiness and build a true European Defence Union; believes that Europe’s common defence needs to take shape with a view to streamlining spending and European coordination; recalls that the adoption of the Strategic Compass was a good starting point, but that its timely implementation remains necessary; welcomes the recent EU Defence instruments, insists on the urgency to change scale as the EU defence efforts cannot remain limited in size, fragmented in scope and lengthy in delivery; calls for a quantum leap and a new approach on Defence, assorted with strong choices and decision, an action plan and a short to long term planning to invest in Defence: underlines that it requires vision, concreteness and shared commitments, both in the strictly military field and in the industrial, technological and intelligence sectors;
